name: Shingū (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Shingū town emblem in white: a crescent-shaped stroke with two small discs, like a stylised swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Shingū, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in August 1977.

features.role: Shingū town emblem — a crescent-shaped stroke with two small discs, like a stylised swirl
